body.name: Exact graph-legality stratum in a saturated order
body.construction: For a saturated ordered super-architecture \(T\), a graph \(G\in\mathcal G(\mathcal P)\), and source masses \(p_T\), declare the primitive feature \(e\in\mathcal I_T\) active exactly when \(Z_e(T,p_T)>0\), and absent exactly when \(Z_e(T,p_T)=0\).  Apply the finite latent-and-selection projection to this active-feature graph.  The formula \(\Psi_{T,G}(p_T)\) is the disjunction of precisely those complete sign patterns whose projection equals \(G\).  The table comparisons in every \(Z_e\) range over all endogenous inputs, including inputs outside observational support.
